sections.title: THE ECB BLOG
sections.body: THE ECB BLOG From peak back to target: tracking expectations during the inflation surge 31 March 2026 Inflation expectations are crucial for monetary policy as they shape economic decisions and feed through to inflation. While expectation surveys provide insights, they come with blind spots. Source: European Central Bank, 2026-04-05.

sections.title: SupTech can make anti-money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism supervision more effective, the EBA…
sections.body: SupTech can make anti-money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism supervision more effective, the EBA finds The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published a Report on the use of technology tools in anti-money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism (AML/CFT) supervision (SupTech). Source: European Banking Authority, 2026-04-05.
